currencies.name: Copper
currencies.use: Pays recurring possession expenses and is the main spendable resource.

currencies.name: Evil
currencies.use: Unlocks Dark Magic and scales Dark Magic training.

currencies.name: Essence
currencies.use: Unlocks Almightiness and scales Almightiness training.

currencies.name: Evil Perk Points
currencies.use: Buys permanent age reductions and, later, an Essence multiplier.

currencies.name: Dark Matter
currencies.use: Funds doctrines and the Dark Orb generator after Collapse.

currencies.name: Dark Orbs
currencies.use: Buys permanent-per-run Magic XP, Essence, income, and warp upgrades.

currencies.name: Metaverse Points
currencies.use: Funds a refundable perk loadout between Metaverse runs.

currencies.name: Hypercubes
currencies.use: Buys altar ranks that improve generation, boosts, Essence, and Dark Matter.

rebirths.name: Touch Eye
rebirths.reward: Records task maximum levels for a permanent per-task XP multiplier.
keeps: mastery discoveries, tiers, and passive effects
enabled automation choices until the application closes

rebirths.name: Embrace Evil
rebirths.reward: Awards Evil and unlocks cross-career auto-promotion, Echo I, Resonance I, and Evil Perk Points after the first completion.
keeps: mastery discoveries, tiers, and passive effects
enabled automation choices until the application closes

rebirths.name: Transcend
rebirths.reward: Awards Essence, unlocks the Shop Steward after the first completion, and retains floored task maximum levels scaled by Cosmic Recollection.
keeps: mastery discoveries, tiers, and passive effects
enabled automation choices until the application closes

rebirths.name: Collapse
rebirths.unlock: Heroic XIV and at least 50,000,000,000 Essence
rebirths.reward: Awards Dark Matter from current Essence and unlocks Darkness progression.
resets: all normal and Great task levels, XP, and maximum levels
keeps: current, lifetime, and run Dark Matter plus Collapse count
Dark Orbs, generator and upgrade ranks, and doctrines
Great promotion status and Great item conversions
Evil perks, milestones, Chronicle, and permanent unlocks

rebirths.name: Metaverse
rebirths.unlock: Darkness XIII and a positive award from run Dark Matter
rebirths.reward: Awards Metaverse Points and opens a refundable perk loadout before the next run.
resets: Dark Orbs and unpreserved Dark upgrades
Hypercubes, altars, and the Reality Boost
keeps: lifetime Dark Matter and Metaverse Points
Great promotion status and Great item conversions
mastery progress, Resonance memories, milestones, and Chronicle

limitations: The game is single-player and supports one local player.
The game does not progress while closed.
Automation toggles, loadouts, and ability Skip choices are session-only.
The light-theme choice is session-only; audio and sticky-header settings are saved.
Long pauses may take time to catch up after play resumes.
